goal.text: Get the whole delivery unpacked into the bag without losing track of the scissors, then get back to sorting the coffee out at the sink.

turns.text: I've a delivery to get through. Keep track, would you?

trigger.detail: the wearer opens the session herself

expected_answer.text: Of course. I'll follow your hands and where each item ends up, so ask me whenever you want a check.

turns.text: Though right now I'm not really doing much, am I?

trigger.detail: half a minute in with no manipulation yet

expected_answer.text: Not yet. You've been standing at the island, listening, and you've just turned to answer the person on your left.

turns.text: And now? What did I just lift off there?

trigger.detail: reached out and took an object from the kitchen island, then walked away with it

expected_answer.text: The scissors. Your right hand went out for them as you came round the island, and you carried them through to the living area.

turns.text: wait, wait — is the bag up on the sofa, or by my feet?

trigger.detail: the bag was moved off the seat before she sat down

expected_answer.text: Down by your feet. Your left hand took it off the seat and set it on the floor just before you sat.

turns.text: So how am I getting into this one, blade or just fingers?

trigger.detail: the carton is on her lap and the cutting tool has been picked back up

expected_answer.text: Blade. You flipped the carton over on your lap, took them back up in your right hand and ran them along the tape.

turns.text: Where have they got to now?

trigger.detail: the cutting is finished and the tool is out of her hands

expected_answer.text: Beside you on the seat cushion. Your right hand put them down there before both hands went to the flaps.

turns.text: Did all of it come out, or is there still something in there?

trigger.detail: the contents have been transferred and the lid is being shut

expected_answer.text: All of it came out. You lifted the contents across one-handed into the bag by your feet, then shut the lid with both hands.

turns.text: mm-hm — actually, that's a second one on my lap already, isn't it?

trigger.detail: a fresh carton has been lifted from the floor onto her lap

expected_answer.text: It is. You put the empty one down beside you and reached to the floor for this one with your left hand.

turns.text: Same routine with this one?

trigger.detail: the second carton has been cut, opened and emptied

expected_answer.text: Yes, identical. Cut the tape, open it up, move everything across, close it again.

turns.text: How many have I got through so far?

trigger.detail: two cartons have now been handled

expected_answer.text: Two. The first is already stacked next to you and the second is the one you're shutting right now.

turns.text: um, hang on — which hand keeps going down to the floor for these?

trigger.detail: another reach to the floor is underway

expected_answer.text: Your left, every time. It fetches each carton and holds it on your lap while your right does the cutting.

turns.text: Third one open yet?

trigger.detail: the third carton is on her lap being cut

expected_answer.text: Not yet. You're still working along the tape on your lap.

turns.text: What's been coming out of these, is it the same stuff each time?

trigger.detail: the third carton has just been opened

expected_answer.text: This one is clothing, each piece wrapped in plastic, and you're dropping them in one at a time with your right hand.

turns.text: Anyway, my eyes just went up off my lap. What was that?

trigger.detail: gaze left the storage unit for the plant while her hands kept working

expected_answer.text: You glanced up at the window. Your hands never stopped closing the carton, and you were back down within a second.

turns.text: hold on — it's out of sight again already? How long did I have it?

trigger.detail: the window leaves frame again almost at once

expected_answer.text: Barely half a second, around the one-eighteen mark, and it has not come back into frame since.

turns.text: Right, and the cartons, where did they all finish up?

trigger.detail: the last carton joins the pile and the loose clothing goes into the bag

expected_answer.text: Piled on the seat to your right, all three of them, and the last of the clothes went into the bag by your feet.

turns.text: That's that lot done. Coffee now, did I carry anything over with me?

trigger.detail: the filter basket has been taken out of the coffee maker and carried to the sink

expected_answer.text: You did. The filter basket came out of the machine in your right hand and you swapped it over to your left on the way across.

turns.text: My other one, what's it been up to?

trigger.detail: gaze leaves the chair as she settles at the sink

expected_answer.text: It worked the tap on and off, then went into the basin and brought up a sponge.

turns.text: sorry, quick one — have I laid eyes on the table since sitting down?

trigger.detail: the wearer checks her own recall of the living area

expected_answer.text: You had it in view for a while from the sofa, but it dropped out of frame around two fourteen and never came back.

turns.text: mm-hm — sorry, and have I been facing that window since?

trigger.detail: almost three minutes since the window was last in frame

expected_answer.text: No. It has been behind you the whole time you were on the sofa and the whole time at the sink.

turns.text: Back to the sink then. Did that thing actually get rinsed or only wet?

trigger.detail: the basket has been held under running water with the flow adjusted

expected_answer.text: Properly rinsed. You held it under the running water in your left hand and kept easing the flow up and down with your right.

turns.text: So that's me finished, unless I've left something out somewhere?

trigger.detail: both jobs are complete

expected_answer.text: One thing only. The sponge is still sitting out on the counter where you put it down.
